title: eval-harness: per-prompt CI metrics + quality gating enhancements
author: Priya Patel
description: Motivation: improve our per-prompt CI coverage and make quality gating more actionable for model rollouts. This PR implements a lightweight per-prompt metrics exporter, enriches CI hooks to compute prompt-level regressions, and adds a configurable quality gating layer that fails the pipeline when specified thresholds are exceeded. Changes include: a new per_prompt_metrics module that aggregates accuracy/coverage/regression deltas; CI workflow updates to run per-prompt evals in parallel and upload metrics to the existing metrics service; new gating policy config and a small evaluator to compare current run to baseline thresholds stored in eval-harness/ci/baselines; tests and docs. Backwards compatibility: gating is opt-in via ci/gating.yaml; default behavior is no-op. Rollout plan: enable in staging for two weeks with alerting to #eval-harness before enabling on main CI. Related: ENG-2345 for rollout tracking and SUP-9876 for customer regressions triage. Checklist: [x] per-prompt metrics exporter implemented [x] CI workflow wired [x] gating config + evaluator [x] unit tests [x] integration test run [x] docs updated. Notes: kept changes small and isolated to eval-harness and CI workflows; no runtime serving changes included.

release_notes: Added per-prompt CI metrics and an opt-in quality gating mechanism for eval-harness. Teams can configure gating thresholds via eval-harness/gating/ci_gating.yaml and use the per_prompt_metrics exporter to capture prompt-level deltas. This improves early detection of prompt-specific regressions before model rollouts.
notes: Staged rollout: enable in staging for 2 weeks and monitor eval-harness gating alerts in #eval-harness. If false positives occur, gate can be disabled by setting 'enabled: false' in ci_gating.yaml.
